news.title: Sanctioned 22-Year-Old Tanker Makes Rare Late-Season Arctic Voyage
news.summary: A 22-year-old product tanker sanctioned by the European Union is making an unusual late-season voyage along Russia's Northern Sea Route, highlighting the growing use of older, lower-specification vessels to move petroleum products through the Arctic.

news.title: Port of Savannah Sets September Container Record as Imports Rise

news.title: Ships Take Long Way Around as Drought Snarls Panama Canal
news.summary: Maritime traffic through the Strait of Magellan jumped more than 70% both in August and September from year-ago levels as ships diverted from the drought-stricken Panama Canal, Chilean Navy data requested by Bloomberg show.
